CustomField.description: External identifier used by FQS seed scripts for idempotent upserts and teardown. Pattern: FQS-<OBJ>-<idx>[-<subidx>]. NOT unique at the platform level: the managed frops_flow__PauseResumeSchedule (and other schedule-cloning managed actions) create the successor GCS via sObject clone, which copies custom-field values including External_Id__c and would collide on any unique=true field. Uniqueness is instead guaranteed by the seed's own naming convention (RUN_STAMP + globalIdx + kind); no other writer of GCS should populate this field.
CustomField.label: External ID
